subject: Renewal pricing: staggered accelerator & usage-safeguard ask
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@entwinehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Leung <matthew.leung@entwinehealth.com>, contracts@entwinehealth.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal ask — staged accelerator + usage-safeguard

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from our side as we prep renewal planning: we expect a ~65% uplift in inference consumption over the next 12 months driven by two pilots rolling to prod. Procurement is asking if Redwood can offer a staged discount schedule tied to concrete usage milestones (so Entwine gets predictable unit economics while Redwood preserves committed revenue).

Key asks:
- A 3-stage accelerator: 10% at +20% usage, 15% at +40%, 20% at +65% (applied to tokens over base commit).
- A 90-day proof-of-usage window (roll-forward trigger) so we don't lose credits if usage spikes early.
- Agreement that co-terming aligns to our existing March renewal.

We can share an updated forecast and SOW if helpful — attaching the draft Entwine SOW with updated seats/usage. Can Redwood commit to structuring this as an amendment + short SOW addendum? If you can share a finance-friendly sketch this week it would help our internal review.

Thanks,
Sara
--
Sara Kim
VP, Partnerships | Entwine Health
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@entwinehealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal ask — staged accelerator + usage-safeguard

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear asks and the updated SOW. We can definitely structure a staged accelerator; appreciate the specificity on bands. High level response:

- Staged bands: can propose 8% / 14% / 20% to balance runway for larger spikes (we bumped the first band slightly down to preserve baseline economics).
- Proof-of-usage window: 90 days is reasonable; we'll propose a roll-forward that preserves unused credits within the 90-day window and a 6-month follow-on cleanup for reconciliation.
- Co-terming: yes — we'll co-term to your March renewal and reflect the amendment schedule in the SOW addendum.

I'll loop in Lauren (pricing lead) and Ben (revenue ops) to draft the exact amendment language and a simple billing matrix. Expect a first-pass PDF + spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm the updated forecast is attached in the SOW (we saw the line items but want the month-by-month run rate if available)?

Best,
Rafael
--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Entwine staged accelerator proposal (draft)

Raf — drafting the attachment. Short summary of options for negotiation below (attached spreadsheet: staged-discount-matrix.xlsx).

Option A (conservative): 6% / 12% / 18% applied to marginal tokens over base commit; 90-day proof window; reconciliation quarterly; no retro credits after 6 months.
Option B (balanced, recommended): 8% / 14% / 20% (marginal tokens) + 90-day lookback + 6-month reconciliation window; early spike protection (first-time override once in 12 months).
Option C (aggressive): 10% / 16% / 22% + 120-day proof window; requires 12-month minimum top-up commitment.

Notes / ops considerations:
- Billing system: Ben — we need a mapping to usage buckets so accounting can automate overage credits; prefer per-invoice line item rather than credit memos.
- Legal: we should keep amendment language narrow (band triggers + reconciliation schedule + co-term clause).
- Sales credits / discounts: grace — confirm whether CS discount policy should apply here or if we keep margins at sales discretion.

I attached a draft SOW addendum (Entwine_SOW_v2.pdf) with the Option B language highlighted. Rafael — if you want to present Option B as the recommended path, we can prepare a short one-pager for Sara and procurement.

Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@entwinehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Leung <matthew.leung@entwinehealth.com>, contracts@entwinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal ask — staged accelerator + usage-safeguard

Rafael / team — thanks for the quick turn. Option B looks workable from our side (14% mid-band is attractive). Two small asks before we route to procurement:
1) Can Redwood provide the billing line-item example (how it will appear on our invoice) so Matthew can sign off with finance?
2) If we accept Option B, can we lock the first band to apply retroactively from the start of the first pilot month if usage exceeded the +20% threshold? That helps smooth our cashflow modeling.

If we get those two items today we can push the amendment to contracts for redlines and aim to sign next week. Also please send the DocuSign link when ready.

Appreciate it — Sara
--
Sara Kim
VP, Partnerships | Entwine Health
